faq.q: How much does The Law Office of Ali Najmi charge?
faq.a: The Law Office of Ali Najmi publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does The Law Office of Ali Najmi offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. The Law Office of Ali Najmi publishes a free initial consultation.

faq.q: Where does The Law Office of Ali Najmi have offices?
faq.a: The Law Office of Ali Najmi publishes one office, in Manhattan. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at The Law Office of Ali Najmi?
faq.a: The Law Office of Ali Najmi names three attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. 1 of 3 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status. 2 could not be told apart from namesakes in the register and are counted neither way.

faq.a: The Law Office of Ali Najmi scores 42 and sits at Verified. Passed: licensure, discipline, website and footprint. Did not pass: entity registration.
